name: M2-1 tail side of the final minute (mirror of D2-2)
registered: 2026-11-27, before any M2-1 run; brief 2026-11-27 (Dublin box)
fee_note: fee per share = fee * p * (1 - p), flat post-2026-11-21 rates on all ten days (the real pre-switch fee was 0.07; a sensitivity row at 0.07 for 11-14..20 is reported, not used for the pick). The brief gives 0.05 for BTC 15m and 0.01 for ETH 5m; BTC 5m uses 0.05 (its post-switch rate).
samples: dublin1124/d2_samples.py --final: 1 s samples from 60 to 5 s left; only rows with a finite fvcl (Chainlink stream as S, twap60 at the start second as K). The Binance-based z / phi / mv1 fields are not used (R-D3 embargo).

cells.also: the same grid split by strike-gap sign: kgap = 1e4 (K - Chainlink(start)) / Chainlink(start), signed so positive favours the side; toward = kgap > 0, against = kgap <= 0

trade: one FAK per window per side per cell at the first sample in the cell; matched at t + 205 ms against the standing top of book (fills if that ask <= the limit with >= 5 shown, pays that ask); pessimistic fill = the paid price still shows >= 5 shares at t + 305 ms. Extra rows: match at t + 330 ms, pessimistic at t + 430 ms (separate sampler run with MATCH_MS=330, PESS_MS=430).
per_cell: edge_net c/share = win - paid - fee p(1-p) over filled
SE by window floored at the binomial SE at the paid price
freeze_rule: at most 2 cells over all markets and both grids (unsplit and strike-gap split): >= 30 filled windows on the ten days, edge_net > 0 with t >= 2.5, edge_net > 0 in both halves, pessimistic edge_net > 0. If more than 2 qualify, take the 2 with the largest t. If none: M2 closed, no holdout.

holdout.days: the first 14 fully recorded days (24 act, pm and twap60/chainlink hour files) from 2026-11-29
holdout.pass: edge_net >= +3 c/share with t >= 2, pessimistic edge_net > 0, >= 40 fills
